invariants.rationale: The method either returns 'fileId' or the result of BulkInsertPartitioner.super.getFileIdPfx(partitionId), both of which are expected to be non-null for correct downstream use.
If fileId is not null, result must equal fileId, otherwise result is from the super call.
If fileId is null, result cannot be equal to fileId; otherwise, result equals fileId.
If fileId is null, result must be what the superclass method returns; otherwise, it does not equal the super call result.
At least one of fileId or the super call result must be non-null if result is always non-null.
